G SUNDARI 
+91 9500547285| sundarigunasekar05@gmail.com 
 | Chennai, India 
 
Middle Office professional with 5.5 years of experience in Capital Markets and Investment Banking Operations, 
in Indian Listed Derivatives (Futures & Options), Trade Booking, Clearing, Settlement and Middle Office Operations. 
Hands-on experience in managing the end-to-end trade lifecycle, including trade validation, give-up/take-up 
processing, clearing, settlement, exception management, and trade, cash and position reconciliations. Experienced in 
supporting institutional clients, traders, brokers, custodians and clearing members while ensuring timely resolution of 
operational queries and settlement breaks. Strong knowledge of Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD), Cash Equities, 
Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, ABS & MBS products. Proficient in client onboarding, account setup, portfolio 
migrations, account closures, SWIFT payment processing (MT202, MT299 & MT105), accounting entries, 
settlement instruction (SSI) validation, operational risk controls. Skilled in market data validation, corporate action 
analysis, root cause analysis, audit support, UAT testing, process improvement and process documentation. Strong 
analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management skills with focus on delivering exceptional client service.
